title: Affine Artin-type bound for the constructible weak Serre coproduct class over a profinite geometric base
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, a finite subextension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a finite commutative ring $A$ killed by a power of $\ell$. Let $\Lambda\in\{A,\mathbf Z_\ell,\mathcal O_E,\mathbf Q_\ell,E\}$, with the discrete topology for $A$ and the induced $\ell$-adic topology otherwise [sk-def-localizing-closure]. Its condensed ring uses all continuous maps from profinite sets. For a scheme $T$ put $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ and $\mathcal A_T=\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_T}$, using ordinary uncompleted module-object derived categories [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull] and the small-site/indexing universe [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathcal P_T$ be the intersection of all replete classes in $\mathcal A_T$ containing zero and all finite constant scalar-model constructible modules [sk-def-sfb-constructible], closed under kernels and cokernels of maps between members, extensions, and all small ambient coproducts. Extension closure means that in $0\to M'\to M\to M''\to0$ membership of both ends implies membership of the middle. 
Let $C$ be an affine reduced zero-dimensional w-contractible scheme whose residue fields are separably closed [sk-def-pe-wlocal]; zero-dimensional means that every prime of its affine coordinate ring is maximal. Let $g:U\to C$ be a finite-type morphism with $U$ affine [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $e\geq0$ be an integer, and assume that for every geometric point $\bar c:\operatorname{Spec}K\to C$ with $K$ algebraically closed, the fibre $U_{\bar c}=U\times_C\operatorname{Spec}K$ has topological Krull dimension at most $e$ [def-weil-geometric-fibre, def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Then for every $N\in\mathcal P_U$ and every integer $q>e+2$,
$$H^q\bigl(R\Gamma(U_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},N)\bigr)=0.$$
Here $R\Gamma$ is right-derived global sections of the ordinary internal $\Lambda_U$-module category with values in $D(\mathbf{Ab})$, and $N$ is in degree zero. No properness, Noetherianity, finite presentation of $g$, invertibility of $\ell$, or completeness of $N$ is assumed. Empty schemes and zero-dimensional fibres are included.

proof.text: The affine spectrum of C has topological dimension at most zero. For every geometric point s, each affine pointed etale neighborhood N is reduced and has dimension at most zero, by etale preservation of reducedness and the proved source dimension inequality for etale morphisms. Localize its coordinate ring at the pointing kernel q. Mathlib Ring.KrullDimLE.isField_of_isReduced makes this local ring a field. An element evaluating to zero therefore vanishes in that localization and is killed by an element outside q. The latter evaluates nontrivially, so becomes a unit in the strict henselization. Using the affine pointed-neighborhood colimit, this proves that the evaluation kernel is zero. It is the maximal ideal, so the strict henselization is a field. Its known separably closed residue field identifies with that field by the bijective residue map. No comparison with a separately chosen algebraic strict henselization is needed.

proof.text: For an affine etale v:V→U, form f=v followed by g. Its strict-local fibre is affine and locally of finite type over the strict-local field. For any algebraically closed geometric point c, pullback pasting identifies the fibre of f with an etale scheme over the fibre of g. The existing proved source inequality Scheme.Hom.topologicalKrullDim_le_of_etale gives the bound e. It uses discrete fibres, so no local-ring dimension theorem or surjectivity hypothesis is necessary.

proof.text: Extend the strict-local field H to its algebraic closure. The closed source theorem topologicalKrullDim_pullback_eq_of_field, recorded by the source audit of lem-pc-dim-base-change, and pullback pasting identify the dimension with that of a geometric fibre from the hypothesis. Hence the strict-local fibre has dimension at most e. Apply the existing source specialization subsingleton_H_of_lt_of_isAffine_of_isSepClosed of the affine Artin theorem: its separably closed field has torsion cohomological dimension zero and the affine fibre has torsion cohomology zero above e, including the empty fibre.

proof.text: For a torsion abelian sheaf F on V, inverse image to the strict-local fibre is torsion. The upstream strictHenselizationStalkFormula identifies the higher direct image stalks with the fibre cohomology from the preceding step. Compare bounded-below total derived homology with the ordinary right derived functor on F[0], and compare Sheaf.H with derived-section cohomology. Every geometric stalk of R^q f_*F is zero for q>e. Geometric stalk conservativity, applied to its identity and zero endomorphisms, gives that this sheaf is zero.

proof.text: The homeomorphism from C to its affine spectrum transports maximality of all primes to closedness of all its points. The affine closed separably closed point acyclicity theorem kills positive cohomology of every abelian sheaf on C. Apply the proved Leray vanishing bound subsingleton_H_of_rightDerived_lowerStar with base bound zero and higher direct image bound e. Compare Sheaf.H with the derived cohomology in HasTorsionEtaleCohomologicalDimensionLE. This yields the required uniform torsion bound on every affine etale V→U.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-NC-a5d5af77d (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read the item and the new node lem-sfb-torsion-cd-topological-serre-transfer in full, the statement of every node they cite (including the blueprint_update texts of the stalk formula, stalk conservativity and finite-type nodes) and the cited place in the blueprint, main-20261015 det-sf-comp-coherence-refinement proof (2). The item's statement and stmt_deps are byte-identical to its base copy in the NA snapshot, where its proof was empty. Step 1: R_c is a reduced ring with a single prime, so it is the field kappa(c); the pair (kappa(c), id) is terminal in the pointed-etale category, so the strict henselization is kappa(c); the affine comparison lemma gives C_(c) -> C = Spec kappa(c) -> C. Step 2: the etale ring map is of finite type; lem-sc-etale-local-dimension bounds every prime chain of the affine V_cbar by e without needing surjectivity; h is affine, hence qcqs. Step 3: dimension is invariant under field extension, the residue field has torsion cd 0, and the affine torsion theorem applies to V_c (with its empty clause). Steps 4-5: the stalk formula's hypotheses (qcqs h, torsion F) hold, conservativity at one geometric point per point gives R^q h_* F = 0, lem-cbc-affine-sepclosed-etale-acyclic makes global sections on C exact without Noetherianity, and the exact-sections Leray node gives H^q(V,F) = 0 for q > e and every affine etale V. Step 6 applies the new node with X = U and d = e; its coefficients, topologies, generators and closure operations match the item's word for word. proof_deps equals the union of the uses. The new node carries a statement only, is self-contained, and its stmt_deps exist. It is not a relabelling (D1/D2): it has no geometric family, no base and no fibre hypothesis, and the geometric work stays in Steps 1-5. My rg search over dag/nodes (weak-Serre and torsion-cd nodes) found no duplicate; the closest are lem-sfb-higher-direct-image-affine-etale-bound, -zero-dimensional-base-affine-global, -noetherian-proper-heart-uniform-bound, -integral-proper-cohomological-bounds, -finite-classical-localizing and -etale-module-affine-bound. Edge cases: A = 0 and empty X are vacuous; a separably closed point is w-contractible; for finite A everything is classical and the bound is d; for Spec F_q with Z_ell coefficients the bound is d+1 = 2 < 4 (the claim is q > d+2). I found no counterexample. Its source is honestly marked WANTED, and the report avoids the false shortcut that a vanishing class is closed under kernels. The 14 off-unit tool_uses are generic etale-cohomology black boxes; accepted. No SGA is cited. No fixes.
